title.narrative: Strengthening peace mediation practice for ceasefires in inclusive peace processes

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is to reduce violence and build peace by strengthening ceasefire mediation practice. This will be achieved by enhancing conflict actors¿ and third parties¿ (local, national, and international) capacity to prepare, negotiate, mediate and implement ceasefires to work towards more inclusive peace processes.
